properties.Mechanism (MOA): Inhibits SGLT2 in proximal tubule → glucosuria + natriuresis/osmotic diuresis → ↓ plasma volume/↓ preload; improves cardiac/renal outcomes → reduces HF hospitalization and improves prognosis (benefit in HFrEF and HFpEF).
properties.Contraindications: Severe renal impairment below agent-specific eGFR threshold; history of ketoacidosis; volume depletion/hypotension (relative); pregnancy (relative/avoid).
properties.Indications: Type 2 diabetes; heart failure (HFrEF and HFpEF benefit); CKD (depending on guideline/renal function).
properties.Adverse effects: Genital mycotic infections/UTIs; volume depletion/hypotension; euglycemic DKA (rare); very rare Fournier gangrene.
